reportOnlyUntil: Drew's review — no apply is authorized by this PR
finding: CF-A-FINISH-TOKEN-IS-ONE-TOKEN (Drew, 2026-09-07). 14951 card_catalog rows sit on a NON-CANONICAL Pokemon finish token. The canonical tokens are 'holofoil' and 'reverse-holofoil', chosen by the mint-lane vocabulary (scripts/lib/pokemon-finish-vocab.cjs, #1935) and confirmed by source: the checklist-side scrape 'pokemon-tcg-data-scraped-2026-08-14' already spells them that way (27,559 reverse-holofoil + 12,039 holofoil), while every non-canonical spelling is ingest-auto-seed or sales-attested. RETIRE where the canonical twin already exists (the checklist/attested twin wins); RESLUG where the address is vacant. Graded children follow their parent row and are never given their own entry.
note: Occupied destinations adjudicated against the tcgdex checklist and prod point reads: every occupant is the SAME card under a fuller spelling. Folds converted from reslug to retire; rows whose SEED side carries the fuller checklist name are withheld to the collisions report rather than retired. REVISION 2026-09-07 (the occupied-unnamed pass): the report still refused 9 entries in THIS list as 'occupied: unnamed'. Point-read against prod, each destination twin carries a playerName BYTE-IDENTICAL to the source's — a Japanese name that playerIdentityKey's a-z0-9 reduction empties on both sides, so the guard read blank-vs-blank as unknown and refused rather than folding. Same set, same cardNumber, same year, same isAuto on both rows; the only difference is the finish spelling this fold exists to collapse. All 9 are converted from reslug to retire, the twin keeps the address, and 0 are folds across players.
